dog.description_text:
Meet Loki! This affectionate, playful boy is the definition of a Velcro cat! He loves being wherever his people are, whether that means curling up on a lap, keeping someone company while they work, or following them around the house. He's friendly with new people, curious about everything, and always happy to get some attention.

When he's not busy supervising his humans, Loki loves sunbathing by the window and watching the birds outside. He's a sweet, social companion with plenty of personality and lots of love to give. Loki is looking for a home where he can be the only pet and get all the attention he deserves!

If this cat is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Loki
